name: Yueluo Duitan
source:
Hundreds of years in the future, the moon is about to fall. Almost all of humanity has chosen to abandon Earth, venturing into the vastness of space in search of a new home.

But you made a different choice — you chose to stay. You chose to witness, with your own eyes, the end of this planet.

When you thought you were the only person within hundreds of miles who had decided to remain, you unexpectedly met a stranger before the town’s clock tower — a woman with fiery red hair.
She called herself “12.”

You decided to stay with each other until the very last moment.

Yet, as you spend more time with 12, you gradually come to realize that this mysterious woman bears a secret that transcends time itself —
a secret deeply connected to you, and to all of us.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4107800]Steam[/url]]
translation:
数百年后，月亮即将坠落。几乎所有人类都选择放弃地球，冒险进入浩瀚的太空寻找新家园。

但你做出了不同的选择——你选择留下来。你选择亲眼目睹这个星球的终结。

当你以为自己是数百英里范围内唯一决定留下来的人时，你意外地在小镇的钟楼前遇到了一个陌生人——一个火红头发的女人。
她称自己为“12”。

你们决定要在一起直到最后一刻。

然而，随着和12相处的时间越来越多，你逐渐发现这个神秘的女人身上隐藏着一个超越时间的秘密——
这是一个与你和我们所有人都息息相关的秘密。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4107800]Steam[/url]]
